The following events took place in '''28 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Cal Omas]] was [[New Republic Presidential election, 28 ABY|elected]] [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]].<ref name="DW" />
*The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] was reorganized into the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].<ref name="DW" />
*Cal Omas established the [[High Council (Galactic Alliance)|High Council]], which included six [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and six [[Politics/Legends|politicians]].<ref name="jvs">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>
*[[Nas Choka]] was [[Escalation|escalated]] to [[Warmaster]].<ref name="FH:I">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]''</ref>
*The [[Ssi-ruu]]k attempted a [[Battle of Bakura (28 ABY)|second invasion]] of [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]].<ref name="FH:II">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]''</ref>
*[[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] escaped [[Coruscant/Legends|Yuuzhan'tar]] with the help of [[Vergere]].<ref name="Traitor">''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]''</ref>
*The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and the [[Hutt underground|resistance movement]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] abandoned the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and moved to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
*The Yuuzhan Vong launched an invasion on the [[Ssi-ruuk Star Cluster]], which resulted in the presumed demolition of the [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium]] and the end to the [[Ssi-ruuvi invasions]].<ref name="ODT" />
*Radical&mdash;and still partially obscure&mdash;changes occurred in the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] and [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] society in general.
*The [[YVH-M]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were created by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]].<ref name="DW" />
